name: Craigslist
description: Craigslist housing rentals: every region worldwide, filtered search of apartments, rooms, sublets and swaps by rent, beds, baths, pets, type and keyword, and full postings with attributes, photos, map location and timestamps.

tools.name: Posting
tools.description: Pass a card's `url` (or its posting_token as posting_id). A numeric post id also needs `region` (and optionally `category`). A deleted or unknown posting is not_found; flagged or expired ones return with flagged/expired true.

options.name: category
options.about: Optional with a numeric posting_id; otherwise all four housing categories are tried.

options.name: posting_id
options.about: Numeric post id (with `region`) or the 22-character token from the posting URL. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9]+$.

options.name: region
options.about: Required with a numeric posting_id: the subdomain hosting the posting. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$.

options.name: url
options.about: Posting URL, new (www.craigslist.org/view/d/...) or legacy (<region>.craigslist.org/<sub>/<cat>/d/<slug>/<id>.html). Pattern: ^https://([a-z0-9-]+\.)?craigslist\.org/.

response.about: One housing posting in full: title, rent and price text, rent period, beds/baths/sqft, housing type, every attribute chip with its source code, pets, laundry, parking, availability, street address and map coordinates with accuracy, photo URLs, plain-text body, posted and updated timestamps, reply availability, flagged/expired state.

fields.name: address
fields.about: Street address when the poster shows one.

fields.name: attribute_params
fields.about: Source attribute codes (housing_type=1, laundry=3, pets_cat=1...).

fields.name: attributes
fields.about: Every attribute chip as displayed.

fields.name: available_from
fields.about: 'now' or an ISO date when stated.

fields.name: baths
fields.about: Numeric bathrooms; 'shared'/'split' stay in attributes.

fields.name: body
fields.about: Posting body as plain text; contact relay links are never included.

fields.name: category
fields.about: Leaf category (apa, roo, sub, swp) from the breadcrumb or reply link.

fields.name: currency
fields.about: Posting pages do not state an ISO currency; always null here (see currency_symbol and the search card).

fields.name: currency_symbol
fields.about: Leading symbol of price_text ($, £, €, C$...).

fields.name: expired
fields.about: True when Craigslist shows 'expired'. A deleted posting is not_found.

fields.name: flagged
fields.about: True when Craigslist shows 'flagged for removal'.

fields.name: housing_line
fields.about: Raw '/ 1br - 670ft2 -' fragment from the title bar.

fields.name: labelled_attributes
fields.about: Labelled attributes such as 'listed by', 'broker fee details', keyed by label.

fields.name: map_accuracy
fields.about: Craigslist map accuracy code (data-accuracy); lower is more precise.

fields.name: posted_at
fields.about: RFC3339 UTC converted from the page's local-offset timestamp.

fields.name: price_text
fields.about: Price as rendered, e.g. "$2,486".

fields.name: rent
fields.about: Digits of the listed price in whole currency units; null when no price is shown.

fields.name: rent_period
fields.about: 'monthly', 'weekly', 'daily' when stated.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.about: RFC3339 UTC; null when never updated.

license.name: Craigslist Terms of Use
license.restrictions: Public posting data retrieved live for the caller's own use. Craigslist's terms prohibit scraping for redistribution, bulk copying and any commercial reuse of postings; contact relay addresses are never stored and photos are URLs only.

tools.name: Regions
tools.description: Find the `region` slug for search (sfbay, newyork, austin, london) or list all regions in a country.

options.name: country
options.about: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 filter (US, CA, GB...). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{2}$.

options.name: query
options.about: Case-insensitive substring over slug, name, state, abbreviation and subarea names.

response.about: Every Craigslist region (subdomain) worldwide with country, state, area id, coordinates, timezone and subareas, optionally filtered by name substring and country.

fields.name: abbreviation
fields.about: Three-letter area abbreviation (sfo, nyc, ldn).

fields.name: area_id
fields.about: Numeric area id used by the search API.

fields.name: country
fields.about: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 from the source.

fields.name: name
fields.about: Region name as Craigslist writes it (Description).

fields.name: region
fields.about: State/province code; null when the source leaves it blank.

fields.name: slug
fields.about: Craigslist subdomain, e.g. sfbay, newyork, london. Stable identifier; use as `region` in search.

fields.name: timezone
fields.about: IANA timezone when the source gives one.

fields.name: url
fields.about: https://<slug>.craigslist.org/

license.name: Craigslist Terms of Use
license.restrictions: Public posting data retrieved live for the caller's own use. Craigslist's terms prohibit scraping for redistribution, bulk copying and any commercial reuse of postings; contact relay addresses are never stored and photos are URLs only.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Search rentals in a region; then call `posting` with a card's url or posting_id for the full text and attributes. Page with `cursor` (pages of 36, up to 91 pages).

options.name: baths_min
options.about: baths_min

options.name: beds_min
options.about: Minimum bedrooms (0 = studio allowed).

options.name: category
options.about: apa apartments/housing for rent, roo rooms & shares, sub sublets & temporary, swp housing swap, hhh all housing.

options.name: cursor
options.about: next_cursor from the previous page. Pattern: ^o:[0-9]{1,5}$.

options.name: furnished
options.about: True to require furnished.

options.name: housing_type
options.about: Any of these types; omit for all.

options.name: max_rent
options.about: Maximum rent in whole units of the region currency.

options.name: min_rent
options.about: Minimum rent in whole units of the region currency.

options.name: no_broker_fee
options.about: True to require no broker fee.

options.name: pets
options.about: Require cats OK and/or dogs OK.

options.name: posted_since_hours
options.about: Only postings posted within this many hours; enforced on the source posted timestamps (Craigslist's own switch is 'posted today' for <= 24).

options.name: query
options.about: Keyword search over title and body.

options.name: region
options.about: Craigslist subdomain or area abbreviation from `regions`. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$.

options.name: sort
options.about: Default newest.

response.about: One page (36 cards) of housing postings in a Craigslist region and category (apa apartments, roo rooms, sub sublets, swp swaps, hhh all housing) filtered by rent range, minimum beds/baths, housing type, pets, furnished, no broker fee, keyword and posting age, sorted newest, rent low/high or relevance. Cards carry post id, title, rent and currency, beds, sqft, neighborhood, coordinates, posted time and photo URLs.

fields.name: baths
fields.about: Always null on cards: the search API does not carry bathrooms. Use `posting`.

fields.name: beds
fields.about: Bedrooms from the search API; 0 means studio; null when not given.

fields.name: category
fields.about: Category searched.

fields.name: category_id
fields.about: Source leaf category id of the posting (1 = apartments/housing).

fields.name: currency
fields.about: ISO currency of the posting's area from the search API area table (USD, GBP, CAD...). Null only for nearby postings whose area is absent from that table.

fields.name: nearby
fields.about: True when Craigslist appended this posting from a nearby region.

fields.name: neighborhood
fields.about: Location text shown on the card (source locationDescriptions).

fields.name: neighborhood_canonical
fields.about: Craigslist's canonical neighborhood name for the location (source neighborhoods).

fields.name: photo_ids
fields.about: Source image ids as returned.

fields.name: photo_urls
fields.about: 600x450 image URLs on images.craigslist.org; URLs only.

fields.name: posted_at
fields.about: RFC3339 UTC, from the search API posted date.

fields.name: posting_id
fields.about: Numeric Craigslist post id (stable, shown as 'post id' on the page).

fields.name: posting_token
fields.about: Token from the posting URL; pass either to `posting`.

fields.name: price_text
fields.about: Price exactly as Craigslist renders it, e.g. "$2,486" or "£80".

fields.name: region
fields.about: Subdomain that hosts the posting (differs from the searched region for nearby results).

fields.name: rent
fields.about: Asking rent in whole units of `currency`, as listed; null when the posting states no price (source -1).

fields.name: source_codes
fields.about: Unmapped source tags (open-house day offsets, dedupe keys) preserved verbatim.

fields.name: sqft
fields.about: Square feet (Craigslist always uses ft²); null when not given (source 0).

fields.name: subarea
fields.about: Subarea abbreviation (eby, sfc, brk...) when the region has subareas.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.about: Always null on cards; the posting page carries the updated time.

fields.name: url
fields.about: Canonical posting page https://www.craigslist.org/view/d/<slug>/<token>.
